description: Targeted NETWORK mappings for a campaign resolved through campaign_tagging_data when the caller holds a non-campaign_id key (a marketing_campaign_id). Point-in-time, no date range. One row per active network target: the resolving marketing_campaign_id, the resolved internal numeric campaign_id, and the network target_details JSON. Source is the OLTP config table os_ads_db_campaign_targeting_mapping (ctm) INNER JOINed to campaign_tagging_data (ctd) on campaign_id+client_id to translate the caller's marketing_campaign_id into the internal campaign_id(s), restricted to network targets that are not deleted (target_type='NETWORK', is_deleted=0). campaign_id (the external filter) maps to ctd.marketing_campaign_id and is mandatory. Python layer derives networks (list) and network_count from these rows.

campaign_id.description: The resolving marketing_campaign_id the caller holds (a non-campaign_id key). Mandatory filter: pass the marketing_campaign_id here; campaign_tagging_data resolves it to the internal campaign_id(s) whose network targeting is returned.

resolved_campaign_id.description: Internal numeric campaign_id that the supplied marketing_campaign_id resolved to (via campaign_tagging_data), and to which this network targeting mapping belongs.

target_details.description: The targeted NETWORK definition for this campaign, serialized as a JSON string (TO_JSON_STRING of the target_details struct).

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level dimension passthrough (network targeting lookup) with no aggregated measure; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.os_ads_db_campaign_targeting_mapping` AS ctm INNER JOIN `prj-onlinesales-prod-01.reporting.campaign_tagging_data` AS ctd ON SAFE_CAST(ctd.campaign_id AS INT64) = ctm.campaign_id AND SAFE_CAST(ctd.client_id AS INT64) = ctm.client_id WHERE ctm.target_type = 'NETWORK' AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND __FILTER__ GROUP BY __ATTRIBUTES_GROUP_BY__;
